Incident history (1)

📅 2026-07-19 Airstrike INC-309
Israeli warplanes fired two missiles at the first floor of the medical facility, claiming the lives of two Palestinians and injuring 16 others, mostly children.

At least two Palestinians were killed and 16 others injured in initial estimates following an Israeli strike targeting Al-Yaman Al-Saeed Hospital in the Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza, according to local sources.
